messageBody: We are a dynamic team driven by a shared passion for creating unforgettable experiences in Tokyo. If you're looking for a challenging yet rewarding career, we invite you to explore opportunities with us.

workConditions.title: Flexible Work Hours
workConditions.details: We offer flexible working hours to accommodate personal circumstances and optimize work-life balance.

workConditions.title: Remote Work Options
workConditions.details: Depending on the role, remote work is available, promoting a diverse and geographically dispersed team.

workConditions.title: Comprehensive Benefits
workConditions.details: Our package includes health insurance, transportation allowances, and performance-based bonuses.

workConditions.title: Professional Development
workConditions.details: Opportunities for continuous learning through workshops, language training, and cultural immersion programs.

workConditions.title: Inclusive Environment
workConditions.details: We foster a diverse and inclusive workplace where every voice is heard and respected.
